vertical_datum.measured: MSL (geoid-referenced), consistent with Copernicus DEM EGM2008
vertical_datum.verification: Sampled at the two published runway thresholds: 04 reads 153.22 m against AIP 154.9 m (-1.68 m); 22 reads 172.28 m against AIP 173.9 m (-1.62 m). An ellipsoidal product would deviate by roughly +36 m in this region, so no geoid separation is applied.
